column6: Upbound Group Q2 2026 earnings report (2026-07-30) reports Acima revenue of $604M and improving credit trends; Acima is an active operating segment, Draper HQ per wiki page; also has an open Manager Data Intelligence posting on its own Workday board.

BASF launched NeoHelix Regenerate (April 2026 in-cosmetics Global, Paris), the first commercial product from its 3Helix CHP partnership, per BASF press release; 3Helix technology is actively licensed and shipping in a launched product.

Own careers board lists 8 open shop-floor and technical positions (autoclave operator, composite layup tech, machine programmer, etc.) as of 2026-08-13; company was acquired by The Thermal Group Feb 2025 (prnewswire.com/news-releases/the-thermal-group-expands-capabilities-with-acquisition-of-act-aerospace-302366031.html) and continues operating under that ownership per ruling 3.
Adobe reported record Q2 FY2026 results (revenue $6.62B, up 13% YoY) on 2026-06-11 and raised FY26 guidance; large ongoing Lehi UT engineering hub per wiki page.

Ancestry own careers board (careers.ancestry.com) lists multiple current Lehi UT openings (e.g. Senior Manager AI Support Enablement, Staff Product Manager Personalization) found live via search 2026-08-13; direct WebFetch of the board is bot-gated (consistent with wiki page note), but ziprecruiter aggregator corroborates active Lehi hiring as of Jul 2026.

No activity found after the 2016-2017 NSF I-Corps award (expired 2017-07-31); araknitek.com no longer resolves, company listed deadpooled on Tracxn/commercial databases, no dissolution filing found so not concluded; USU spider-silk commercialization has continued through other vehicles (Spidey Tek, USU Innovation Campus) per the wiki page itself.

ARUP launched CLARISPECT Multiple Myeloma MRD spectral flow cytometry assay 2026-07-30 (first US reference lab to offer it clinically); also added Cyclospora data to its infectious-disease dashboard in Aug 2026 and opened an Innovation Central Laboratory 2026-02-26 (prnewswire.com/news-releases/arup-creates-innovation-central-laboratory-to-accelerate-diagnostic-innovation-for-biotechnology-and-pharmaceutical-partners-302698170.html).

Atavistik Bio partnered with Cure HHT Clinical Trial Network 2026-07-30 and activated first Harmony-HHT Phase 1/2 clinical site at Mass General Hospital in July 2026, following FDA IND clearance and Fast Track designation for ATV-1601 announced 2026-06-09 (globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/09/3308700). U of U/Jared Rutter-founded science, HQ now Cambridge MA.

auticon group 2025 Impact Report published on Global Autism Awareness Day 2026 (Apr 2) reports 373 autistic technologists employed in 2025 across 15 countries including North America; US careers board live but listed no vacancies on fetch; page is scoped to auticon US (Sacramento HQ, no verified Utah office).

ASI own newsroom 2026-03-11 announces acquisition of Scythe Robotics; work continues under ASI (ruling 3) with Longmont kept and Utah/Texas footprint; related 2026-07-08 Great Place to Work recertification also on asirobots.com.

BambooHR launched Contractor Management (powered by Remote) on 2026-06-29 per GlobeNewswire reprint; Draper-based HR SaaS still shipping product. GlobeNewswire original timed out on fetch; Markets Insider reprint opened.

Last EDGAR filing is Form D/A 2017-05-10 (CIK 0001612629, San Diego NV corp, no revenues); batubiologics.com is parked with unrelated Indonesian content; no 2024-2026 news, grants, trials, or dissolution found so not concluded. Page frames a U of U spinout in SLC but filings and patents are San Diego.

FinSMEs 2025-07-25 reports $6M Series A from DoD Accelerator for Dragonfly UAS and deployable comms kits; St. George own careers page is live with a generic apply CTA (no dated role list on fetch). BusinessWire original timed out.

Own-site public Form 990 for FY ending 2025-09-30 signed by preparer Marc Metcalf 2026-06-30; reports ongoing sanctuary animal-care and national outreach from Kanab HQ. FY25 audited financials also posted (dated 2026-02-06).

Parent bioMérieux H1 2026 results (2026-07-28) report BIOFIRE respiratory and non-respiratory panel sales for H1 2026 (non-respiratory +5.5% organic; respiratory -17% on a soft flu season); work continues in SLC under bioMérieux (ruling 3). GI Panel 1.1 FDA 510(k) submitted 2026-06-30.

openFDA PMA P850064 S058 decision 2026-05-07 (30-day notice received 2026-04-13) for LifePulse Model 204 power-cord incoming-inspection change after a CAPA; manufacturing process still being updated. Also S055 approved 2025-07-25 for patient-circuit material changes.

Last primary public signal is the 2014-07-03 U of U Health press on the PASK/BioEnergenix partnership; no company site, no later grants/trials/filings found. AdisInsight public profile (updated 2023-09-04) lists BioE-1115 discontinued in preclinical; U of U TLO still lists the name as Active (undated directory, not a work signal). No dissolution found.

Nucleus Institute post dated Feb 3 reports Bioparin $306k NHLBI Phase I STTR (Approaches to Enable Large Scale Heparin Bio-Manufacturing, U of U subaward); ResearchNester (opened) places the award in February 2025. No Phase II or 2026 follow-on found; GOED and U of U TLO reprints are undated; NIH Reporter fetch timed out.

SunPower Inc (Orem; the post-bankruptcy buyer of the Blue Raven installation line) reported Q2 2026 revenue of $56.0M from residential installs, with ~1,105 Direct Division projects in the pipeline. Work continues under the parent (ruling 3); customer-facing brand is now SunPower. GlobeNewswire original timed out.

GridInfo reprint of EIA-860/923 (plant 299) shows Blundell generated 71.6 GWh Sep-Dec 2025, annual 271.2 GWh, both units Operating, last update Dec 2025. PacifiCorp-owned hydrothermal plant near Milford still generating (ruling 6).
